overview: Reintroduced flagship sedan for the US market, replacing Avalon. Hybrid-only. Two powertrains: standard 2.5L hybrid (236 hp combined, 41 mpg) and Hybrid MAX 2.4L turbo hybrid (340 hp, 30 mpg combined). Available XLE, Limited, Platinum trims. Source: https://www.toyota.com/crown/ ; https://pressroom.toyota.com/2025-toyota-crown/
